basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old software engineer based in Seattle with a keen interest in emerging technologies and personal wellness. I enjoy exploring the intersection of technology and health, which is why you'll often find me in subreddits discussing biohacking and alternative medicine. I'm an avid gamer in my downtime, with a particular fondness for strategic and tactical games like Project Reality. I work remotely, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit throughout the day, but I primarily engage in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to pursue my hobbies, though I sometimes grapple with loneliness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, I've spent over a decade honing my skills in software development and systems architecture. My interest in health and wellness is largely self-taught, fueled by years of reading scientific journals and engaging in community discussions on platforms like Reddit.
